Lighting Design and Installation in Crawley, Surrey and Sussex

We design and fit lighting for homes and businesses across Surrey and Sussex: chandeliers and pendants, downlights, LED strip, garden lighting and high bay lighting for commercial units.

Call 07813 626998 WhatsApp Us

Stairwells, Halls and Barn Conversions

Our photos show a chandelier hung under a skylight in a curved brick stairwell, a crystal chandelier over a galleried entrance hall, pendants under a vaulted oak ceiling and wall lights on the stone wall of a barn games room in East Peckham. Another shows wall lights being lined up with a laser level.

80 Downlights in Weybridge

On Manor Walk in Weybridge we upgraded 80 downlights, along with other electrical upgrades in the house. Hallways, kitchens and media walls get the same thought: where the light falls, how warm it looks, and whether it dims.

High Bay Lighting for Warehouses

In Crawley we installed high bay lighting in a commercial unit on Woolborough Lane. A Checkatrade customer in RH10 had a warehouse rewired and wrote that they were very happy with the high bay lighting Scott designed for them. Office lighting upgrades take about 30 minutes per light.

Where Lighting Jobs Go Wrong

Scott's view is that some installers just fit the fittings without thinking about the room: lights in the wrong place, too dim, the wrong colour temperature, no dimming. We plan the positions, the levels and the controls first, then fit quality products such as Philips, Ansell Lighting and Thorn Lighting.

Signs It Needs Looking At

These are general signs, not a diagnosis. If you spot one, give us a call and we'll talk it through.

  • Lights that flicker or buzz
  • A circuit that trips when the lights go on
  • Scorching round a fitting or a switch
  • Outside lights that fill with water

Useful to Tell Us

  • Which rooms or areas, and whether it is new lighting or a change
  • Whether you already have the fittings, or want help choosing
  • For outside lighting, where the nearest power is
